{{Quote|We have Aurilian contacts scattered around the galaxy. If you find one, they will be happy to shuttle you back here for a small fee.|[[Maximillian]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:A" />}}
'''Aurilia's Starship Services''' was the company that managed the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in the hidden township of [[Aurilia]] on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was established after the reconstruction of the village, following the [[battle of Aurilia]],<ref name="SWG:A" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> [[Maximillian]] served as the spaceport travel liaison in Aurilia.<ref name="SWG:A" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aurilia's Starship Services appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:A" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Aurilia's Starship Services was added to the game along with the revamped city of [[W:c:swg:Aurilia|Aurilia]],<ref name="SWG:A" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|Chapter 7]]" update on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref> Its name was revealed by a sign in front of the spaceport.<ref name="SWG:A" />
